info.name: Obiente Native Bridge
info.summary: Optional, authenticated server capabilities for Obiente native clients
info.description:
Obiente Native Bridge is an optional companion for independent Obiente native clients. It exposes narrowly scoped APIs only where an installed server app does not already provide a suitable authenticated client API.
The first bridge capability lets an authenticated user mint the short-lived secondary key required by Recognize 11 and newer for its DAV people API. The key does not replace normal Nextcloud authentication or DAV ownership checks.
This is an independent, unofficial Obiente project. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Nextcloud GmbH.
